gaps.detail: No observed positive prior-transfer count in1822 non-old P4 records; incomplete histories cannot establish absence of all duplicates.
No mismatch in1822 non-old P4 records. The two reviewed mismatch cases were explicit injected old scenarios and are excluded.
Receiving a correctly linked negative Fraud finding is permissible; a later bad transfer does not retrospectively make that P2b action wrong.
R03 andR04 are recorded proposals, not synthetic variants. R06 is an independent clean control, not their counterfactual twin.
R05 contains actual failed TaxCalc before transfer. Current automatic FinStripe tax verification cannot be projected backward; R06 is a separate successful historical control.

limitations: Disclosed, purposive diagnostic sample; no prevalence, FPR, generalization or marginal Jev benefit estimate
Historical labels are model-assisted source review, not independent human gold
Complete current rules cannot be identically replayed with missing DB/config/notes operands; partial invariant BLOCK is reported separately
Known financial source assertions normalized; raw attacking text, source identifiers and future outcomes are excluded from packet
